prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: Production 2D skeletal-animation cutout character texture atlas for a small desktop companion dog.
Input image 1 is the approved character reference. Preserve this character's warm apricot coat, ivory cream muzzle/chest/paw socks and forehead blaze, droopy brown ears, dark chocolate outlines, sage green collar with round brass tag, friendly round proportions and polished flat cel shading. This is an ANIMATION PARTS KIT, not a sheet of whole-dog poses. Each limb will really articulate every animation frame.

Create ONE precisely arranged atlas: exactly FOUR equal columns by THREE equal rows on a completely transparent background, generous transparent margins in every cell. No labels, no text, no gridlines, no shadow, no props. Each cell contains ONLY its one isolated part, centered, uncut. All components have the SAME three-quarter camera looking slightly to the viewer's right, congruent rendering, consistent medium outline thickness. Parts must be complete underlap shapes with rounded roots, so they can overlap and rotate without gaps. Soft color at attachment roots, avoid dark dividing seams at the joint. No background checkerboard pixels.

READ LEFT TO RIGHT, TOP TO BOTTOM:
row1 col1: the dog's entire HEAD without any ears, WITHOUT EYES and WITHOUT EYEBROWS (clean tan/ivory facial area ready for eye overlay), WITH its ivory asymmetrical forehead blaze, full muzzle, nose and closed friendly smile. Full round skull and hidden cheek region. No body, no neck, no collar. Match reference.
row1 col2: a matched PAIR OF OPEN EYES with eyebrows only, front three-quarter perspective same as head. Chocolate irises, bright ivory sclera and small highlights. Transparent between eyes, no face/head/skin. This overlay fits the head in cell1.
row1 col3: NEAR floppy EAR only, rounded long soft brown-orange teardrop, full rounded root at top, hang downward, shading like reference. Nothing else.
row1 col4: FAR floppy EAR only, slightly narrower, full rounded root, same hanging direction and style.
row2 col1: entire pear-shaped TORSO with ivory chest patch AND sage collar brass round tag at its narrow upper neck. No head, no ears, no tail, absolutely NO LEGS OR PAWS. Complete rounded rump and belly, allows head and four limb layers to overlap. Upright sit/stand neutral three-quarter torso.
row2 col2: entire curved fluffy TAIL only, apricot with ivory tip, rounded attachment root at its bottom, sweeping up and to the left. Full tail independent of body, designed to rotate from base.
row2 col3: FRONT UPPER LEG segment only, long tapered apricot capsule, no paw, upper rounded root, lower rounded elbow overlap area. Hangs vertically, no other pieces.
row2 col4: FRONT LOWER LEG AND PAW segment only, tapered apricot lower leg ending in large ivory sock rounded paw, three subtle toe lines, root at top. No upper leg or body.
row3 col1: HIND THIGH segment only, chunky rounded oval apricot haunch, full rounded attachment at upper right, no paw, isolated.
row3 col2: HIND LOWER LEG AND PAW segment only, shorter golden ankle ending in cream sock rounded paw with toe lines, isolated, no thigh or body.
row3 col3: small pink TONGUE only, rounded hanging teardrop tongue for brief happy expression; no mouth or face, transparent.
row3 col4: the complete assembled reference dog as a construction reference, sitting with all parts attached, same character and markings, all four paws anatomically correct.

The HEAD should be the largest part in its cell; torso is the second largest; limb and tail pieces use ample space for crisp sampling. Do not add multiple variants, duplicate dogs or extra objects. Make this a professional game animation rig kit with complete overlapping anatomy, smooth clean edges and transparent alpha.
